name: Dribble
description:
You bounce your Orb to charge it with energy. Roll Dexterity against your Orb's Difficulty. On a pass, add 1 MP to the Orb and regain a Half Action for this turn. On a failure, the Orb loses all its current MP and you do not regain a Half Action.

You must move at least 10 feet before you can use this Ability again.
